title: Download one document from a bank portal postbox
description: Scrolls the postbox to the row whose text contains the given title, then presses THAT row's Download button and returns the file. The portal marks a document as read when it is downloaded. Matched on any bank's domain by the portal's page metadata and the postbox path.

params.name: title
params.description: Text of the row, as atruvia/list-postbox lists it (a substring is enough).

steps.note: Scrolls the list to the row and clicks nothing: every row has its own Download button.
